title: Envoy static v3: exact path, prefix_rewrite, virtual host domains
claims: match.path /exact forwards only the exact path
prefix /b/ forwards unchanged to its cluster
virtual host domains restrict routing; another Host is not forwarded
not_claimed: Host matching with an explicit port (domains without :* are matched against the bare Host sent by the probes)
retries, timeouts, header manipulation, weighted clusters
source_semantics: Envoy RouteConfiguration: virtual host chosen by domains, routes evaluated in order, first match wins; prefix_rewrite replaces the matched prefix; no matching virtual host or route yields 404. Documentation-inferred unless the upstream differential runs.
